verdicts_or_reports.element: TIME row in SCHEDULE section (Weekly mode)
verdicts_or_reports.expected: After picking a new dose time the TIME field should show only the newly picked time (e.g. "10:00 AM"), matching the PREVIEW, and the old time should be replaced.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The TIME field shows both the old and the new time joined by an arrow: "8:00 AM → 10:00 AM", while PREVIEW only schedules the new 10:00 AM dose.
steps: Open Plan tab and tap the 'Group 1' card to open Edit group
Tap the TIME row (showed 8:00 AM) to open the time picker
Pick 10 o'clock AM and press OK
Observe the TIME row now reads '8:00 AM → 10:00 AM' although PREVIEW lists only 10:00 AM
Repeat with other values (7:00 AM -> 9:00 AM, 9:00 AM -> 8:00 AM) to confirm the stale value is kept alongside the new one

verdicts_or_reports.expected: After picking a new weekly dose time the TIME field should show only the picked time (e.g. "11:00 AM"), replacing the old value, and match PREVIEW.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The TIME field keeps the previously saved time and appends the picked one with an arrow: "8:00 AM → 11:00 AM". PREVIEW and the saved Plan card only use 11:00 AM, so the first time shown is stale.
steps: Precondition: a group already exists and was saved with a Weekly schedule (Plan card 'Group 1' reads 'Every week · Mon · 8:00 AM').
On the Plan tab tap the 'Group 1' card to open Edit group (Schedule mode is Weekly).
Tap the TIME row that shows '8:00 AM'.
In the Select Time dialog choose 11 o'clock AM and press OK.
The TIME row now reads '8:00 AM → 11:00 AM' instead of just '11:00 AM'.
Note: this does NOT happen when creating a brand new group in Weekly mode (the picker replaces the default time there); it reproduces when editing an already saved group.

verdicts_or_reports.element: TIME row in SCHEDULE section (Weekly mode)
verdicts_or_reports.expected: The TIME row should show a single time - the one just picked (10:30 AM) - matching the PREVIEW ("10:30 AM Today", "10:30 AM Nov 21 Sat"). The previously stored 9:30 AM should be replaced.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The TIME row shows the old saved time and the new picked time joined by an arrow: "9:30 AM → 10:30 AM". The PREVIEW below shows only 10:30 AM, so 9:30 AM is a stale leftover value in the field.
steps: Precondition: group exists and is SAVED. On Plan, the saved card reads 'Group 2 | Every week · Sat · 9:30 AM'.
Tap that saved Group 2 card to open 'Edit group' (SCHEDULE = Weekly).
In the Select Time dialog choose 10 o'clock, leave 30 minutes, tap OK.
The TIME row now reads '9:30 AM → 10:30 AM' while PREVIEW reads '10:30 AM Today' and '10:30 AM Nov 21 Sat'.
It reproduces on every edit of a saved group (also seen 8:00 AM -> 11:00 AM). It does NOT show on a brand-new unsaved group, so the group must be saved and reopened first.
